description:
About the Scholarship

The ETH Zurich Excellence Scholarship & Opportunity Programme (ESOP) 2027 is a fully funded Master's scholarship offering CHF 13,500 per semester living stipend plus full tuition fee waiver. Approximately 60 scholarships are available for the 2027/28 academic year. The application window runs 1-30 November 2026 (11:59 AM CET) for Autumn Semester 2027 (HS27) intake.

Financial Coverage

  • CHF 13,500 per semester for living and study expenses (increased from CHF 12,000 from HS27 onwards).
  • Full tuition fee waiver for the regular Master's duration (3 or 4 semesters).
  • Mentorship and access to ETH Foundation's exclusive network.
  • Total package: CHF 40,500-54,000 stipend plus tuition savings over 3-4 semesters.
  • ETH states the scholarship covers full study and living costs during the Master's degree course.

Eligibility and Requirements

  • Very good Bachelor's result: top 10% of Bachelor's programme (grade A). Based on self-assessment.
  • Open to any nationality. International students fully eligible.
  • Applicants currently applying for Master's admission (external applicants).
  • ETH Bachelor students progressing to consecutive Master's programmes.
  • NOT eligible: Those already enrolled in an ETH Master's programme.
  • NOT eligible: Those who already hold a Master's degree.
  • MAS (Master of Advanced Studies) programmes are not eligible.
  • Note: Only ETH Bachelor students may start ESOP with a leave of absence. This does not restrict who can apply.

Application Process

  1. Apply through eApply (ETH online Master application). There is no separate ESOP application.
  2. Must apply in the first application window (1-30 November 2026). Later windows are not valid for ESOP.
  3. Upload additional documents:
  • Master's thesis pre-proposal (guidelines PDF available on official page).
  • Pre-proposal must be self-developed with proper scientific citation.
  • If Master's programme does not require references, provide names of two reference professors who will upload letters.
  1. Possible phone/video interview in February 2027. Ensure contact number in CV is reachable.

Selection and Timeline

MilestoneDate
Application deadline30 November 2026
Possible interviewsFebruary 2027
Decision communicatedEnd of March 2027
Programme startAutumn 2027

Applications evaluated by respective Master's programme Admissions Committees. Final decision by ETH Zurich Rector.

Official Link

  • ESOP page: https://ethz.ch/students/en/studies/financial/scholarships/excellencescholarship.html
  • eApply portal: https://eapply.ethz.ch
  • Contact: Dr. Barbara E. Hellermann, Financial Aid Office
  • Email: studienfinanzierung@sts.ethz.ch
  • Phone: +41 44 632 20 23 / +41 44 632 20 88

Important Notes

  • CHF 13,500 is the official amount for HS27 intake. Older listings showing CHF 12,000 are outdated.
  • ESOP is part of the eApply Master application, not a separate application.
  • December 15 deadline was used in older cycles (pre-2023). Current deadline is 30 November.
  • Additional scholarships at ETH include ETH-D scholarship and department-specific funding.

Contact

  • Email: studienfinanzierung@sts.ethz.ch

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be sent to the contacts above or raised through the channel given on the official announcement page.

About ETH Zurich

ETH Zurich is Switzerland's federal institute of technology in Zurich. It offers undergraduate, master's and doctoral education across engineering, natural sciences, mathematics, architecture and related disciplines. Its research connects fundamental scientific questions with technological applications, supporting international collaboration and training for students interested in advanced study, innovation and scientific discovery.

Official website: https://ethz.ch

How to Apply

Submit your application through the official portal before the deadline: 30 November 2026, 11:59 CET (morning). Read the eligibility requirements carefully and prepare all requested documents — early applications are strongly recommended for competitive awards.

Open the official application page ↗
